Rip off-Don’t go
Feb 2025 • Couples
I came for fish and chips but they are still using their “limited yet menus” for the holiday which I believe ended 4 days ago.
The prices on this limited menu are high.
The waiter was argumentative and tried to tell me the burger was medium when it was rare.
The music was good and diner decor reminds me of home.
Drinks are way over priced.
On the way out they said we had to pay a 8% tax because it is the law.
No other restaurants in Hanoi or in our three weeks in Vietnam have done that.
So this place is marking it up on a lie.
see attached receipts for them and last night.
the 40 VND was for a small water.
Rip off!

Delicious food, friendly staff, reasonable prices, like Steak & Shake with better food.
Oct 2023 • Friends
I went the first time with friends and really enjoyed the experience. The food was delicious, reminded me of food back in the US, Minh the waiter spoke great English and was very accommodating. We sat on the second floor, second table from the window on the right and had a great view of everything outside and in. When I returned with my wife, we got the same table - lucky, I guess. The prices were quite reasonable, delicious food, friendly staff and the atmosphere kind of reminded me of the American chain Steak & Shake. I just got off the phone with a friend from South Africa, I'm sharing it with him after Tet.
